title: Intro to Xcode
line: Build a small SwiftUI app and run it in the Simulator.

project.title: A reading list app
project.brief: Build a new iOS app alone that lists five books. Tapping a book opens a detail screen with a button that marks it as read. Run it in the Simulator.
checks: The project builds with no errors
A List inside a NavigationStack shows at least five rows
The detail view has a Button that changes a @State value

lessons.title: Make a new SwiftUI project
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner Xcode. Make a new iOS App project named Plants with the SwiftUI interface, then tour the navigator, the editor, the inspector and ContentView.swift.
lessons.passes: A project named Plants has an iOS app target and a ContentView.swift file.

lessons.title: See changes in the canvas preview
lessons.goal: Teach the Xcode canvas and the #Preview macro by changing the Hello, world text in ContentView to My plants and watching the preview update as you type.
lessons.passes: ContentView shows the text My plants and still has a #Preview block.

lessons.title: Text, images and modifiers
lessons.goal: Teach SwiftUI views and modifiers in Xcode by building a plant header from a Text in the title font and an SF Symbol leaf Image tinted green, with padding around both.
lessons.passes: The view has a Text with .font and an Image(systemName:) with a color modifier.

lessons.title: Lay out a card with stacks
lessons.goal: Teach VStack, HStack and Spacer in SwiftUI by arranging the leaf, a plant name and a watering note into a PlantCard view with a rounded background, checked in the Xcode canvas.
lessons.passes: A PlantCard view nests a VStack inside an HStack and has a rounded background.

lessons.title: A button that changes state
lessons.goal: Teach @State and Button in SwiftUI by adding a Water button to PlantCard in Xcode that counts how many times the plant was watered and shows the count in a Text.
lessons.passes: A Button raises a @State integer and a Text shows its value.

lessons.title: Run the app in the Simulator
lessons.goal: Teach running an app from Xcode. Pick an iPhone simulator as the run destination, build and run Plants with Cmd+R, tap Water and read a print line in the debug console, then stop the app.
lessons.passes: The app runs in an iPhone simulator and the console prints the count on each tap.

lessons.title: Show many plants in a List
lessons.goal: Teach SwiftUI List in Xcode by making a Plant struct that is Identifiable, an array of five plants and a List that shows one row for each with its name and symbol.
lessons.passes: A List builds its rows from an array of five Identifiable Plant values.

lessons.title: Navigate to a detail screen
lessons.goal: Teach NavigationStack and NavigationLink in SwiftUI by wrapping the plant List in Xcode so each row opens a PlantDetail view with the plant name as its title and the Water button.
lessons.passes: The List sits in a NavigationStack and each row links to a PlantDetail view.

lessons.title: Read and fix build errors
lessons.goal: Teach reading Xcode build errors. Break the Plants app in three small ways, find each one in the Issue navigator, use the fix-it where one is offered and build until it is clean.
lessons.passes: The Plants project builds with no errors and no warnings.
